actions.description: Bulk enrich people by emails or IDs. Supports up to 10 people per request.
actions.name: bulk-enrich-people

details.description: Array of person lookup details. Maximum 10 people per request.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Whether to reveal personal email addresses in the response.

reveal_phone_number.description: Whether to reveal phone numbers in the response.

raw_address.description: Account address. Example: "123 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94105"

owner_id.description: ID of the user who owns this account. Example: "6a0af1f0c9f63c0018aed306"

account_stage_id.description: ID of the account stage. Example: "6a0af1f0c9f63c0018aed307"

crm_id.description: CRM ID for the account. Example: "0015000000ABC123"

name.description: Name of the deal (human-readable). Example: Massive Q3 Deal

owner_id.description: ID of the deal owner in your Apollo team. Retrieve via Get a List of Users. Example: 66302798d03b9601c7934ebf

account_id.description: ID of the target account (company) in Apollo. Find via Organization Search (organization_id). Example: 5e66b6381e05b4008c8331b8

amount.description: Monetary value as a string. Do not include commas or currency symbols; commas cause the amount to be left blank. Example: 55123478

opportunity_stage_id.description: ID of the deal stage in your Apollo team. Retrieve via List Deal Stages. Example: 6095a710bd01d100a506d4bd

closed_date.description: Estimated close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2025-10-30

user_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the task. Example: "6a0af1f0c9f63c0018aed306"

priority.description: The priority of the task. Example: "medium"

due_at.description: The due date of the task in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-05-20T12:00:00Z"

note.description: The note or description for the task. Example: "Follow up with prospect"

contact_id.description: The ID of the contact this task is for. Example: "6a0af1f3f1ce1100203b8047"

account_id.description: The ID of the account this task is for. Example: "6a0af1f0c9f63c0018aed306"

opportunity_id.description: The ID of the opportunity this task is for. Example: "6a0af21285c69e000cc28695"

actions.description: Delete or archive an account in Apollo by setting its existence_level to none
actions.name: delete-account

id.description: The Apollo ID for the account to archive. Example: "6a0af20b832cec00105fb3a7"

actions.description: Delete or archive a contact in Apollo
actions.name: delete-contact

contactId.description: Apollo contact ID to delete. Example: "6a0af20f499fdc0010dfadaf"

actions.description: Archive (soft-delete) an opportunity in Apollo by marking it as closed.
actions.name: delete-opportunity

actions.description: Enrich an organization by domain or Apollo ID
actions.name: enrich-organization

domain.description: The domain of the company to enrich. Example: "apollo.io" or "microsoft.com". Do not include "www.", the "@" symbol, or similar.

id.description: The Apollo ID of the organization to enrich. Example: "5e66b6381e05b4008c8331b8"

actions.description: Enrich a person by email or Apollo ID
actions.name: enrich-person

email.description: The email address of the person. Example: "alice@nango-test.io"

id.description: The Apollo ID for the person. Example: "587cf802f65125cad923a266"

first_name.description: The first name of the person. Example: "Tim"

last_name.description: The last name of the person. Example: "Zheng"

name.description: The full name of the person. Example: "Tim Zheng"

domain.description: The domain name for the person's employer. Example: "apollo.io"

organization_name.description: The name of the person's employer. Example: "Apollo"

linkedin_url.description: The URL for the person's LinkedIn profile. Example: "http://www.linkedin.com/in/tim-zheng-677ba010"

hashed_email.description: The hashed email of the person (MD5 or SHA-256).

reveal_personal_emails.description: Set to true to reveal personal emails.

reveal_phone_number.description: Set to true to reveal phone numbers.

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for phone number delivery (required if reveal_phone_number is true).

run_waterfall_email.description: Set to true to enable email waterfall enrichment.

run_waterfall_phone.description: Set to true to enable phone waterfall enrichment.

actions.description: Retrieve a single account from Apollo.
actions.name: get-account

id.description: The Apollo ID for the account. Example: "6a0af1f0c9f63c0018aed306"

actions.description: Retrieve a single contact from Apollo.
actions.name: get-contact

id.description: The ID of the contact to retrieve. Example: "6a0af1f3f1ce1100203b8047"

actions.description: Retrieve a single opportunity from Apollo.
actions.name: get-opportunity

id.description: The ID of the opportunity to retrieve. Example: "6a0af21285c69e000cc28695"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Pass the value of `next_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit for the first page.

q_organization_name.description: Keywords to narrow the search of accounts. Keywords should directly match at least part of an account name. Example: "apollo"

account_stage_ids.description: Apollo IDs for account stages to include in search results. Call List Account Stages endpoint to retrieve available IDs.

account_label_ids.description: Apollo IDs for labels to include in search results.

sort_by_field.description: Sort matching accounts by the specified field.

sort_ascending.description: Set to true to sort in ascending order. Must be used with sort_by_field. Defaults to false (descending).

per_page.description: Number of results per page. Max 100. Defaults to 100.

owner_id.description: ID of the user who owns this account.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the account was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the account was last updated.

last_activity_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent activity.

phone.description: Phone number associated with the account.

employees.description: Number of employees at the account.

accounts.description: List of accounts matching the search criteria.

total_entries.description: Total number of accounts matching the query.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

q_keywords.description: Keywords to narrow the search. Can include names, job titles, employers, and email addresses.

contact_stage_ids.description: Contact stage IDs to filter by.

contact_label_ids.description: Contact label IDs to filter by.

sort_ascending.description: Sort in ascending order. Requires sort_by_field.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit if on the last page.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 25.

sort_by_field.description: Sort deals by amount (largest first), is_closed (closed deals first), or is_won (won deals first).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Default is 1.

per_page.description: Number of results per page. Default is 25.

actions.description: List users (team members) in the Apollo organisation.
actions.name: list-users

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

actions.description: Remove or stop one or more contacts from an Apollo sequence.
actions.name: remove-contact-from-sequence

contact_ids.description: Apollo contact IDs to remove or stop from the sequence. Example: ["66e34b81740c50074e3d1bd4"]

action.description: Action to perform on the contacts in the sequence. Defaults to remove.

q_organization_domains_list.description: Domain names for the organization (e.g., "apollo.io", "microsoft.com"). Up to 1,000 domains.

q_organization_name.description: Organization name to search for. Partial matches accepted.

organization_ids.description: Specific Apollo organization IDs to include.

revenue_range_min.description: Minimum revenue filter (no currency symbols, commas, or decimals).

q_organization_job_titles.description: Job titles in active job postings.

organization_num_jobs_range_min.description: Minimum number of active job postings.

organization_num_jobs_range_max.description: Maximum number of active job postings.

person_titles.description: Job titles to search for. Example: ["sales director", "vp sales"]

person_seniorities.description: Seniority levels to filter by. Example: ["c_suite", "director", "manager"]

q_organization_domains_list.description: Organization domains to filter by. Example: ["apollo.io", "nango.dev"]

person_locations.description: Person locations to filter by. Example: ["California, US", "New York, US"]

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default: 25

id.description: The Apollo ID for the contact to update. Example: "6a0af1f3f1ce1100203b8047"
The ID of the opportunity to update. Example: "6a0af21285c69e000cc28695"

owner_id.description: The ID for the deal owner within your team's Apollo account.

amount.description: The monetary value of the deal.

opportunity_stage_id.description: The ID for the deal stage within your team's Apollo account.

closed_date.description: The estimated close date for the deal. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.description: Update a task in Apollo. Note: Due to OAuth limitations, the original task cannot be directly modified or deleted. A new task is created with the updated fields, and the original task should be manually deleted in the Apollo UI.
actions.name: update-task

id.description: The Apollo ID of the task to update. This is used for reference only since the original task cannot be modified via OAuth. Example: 6a0af245e3c1270014ee8e23

user_id.description: The Apollo user_id for the task owner. Example: 66a3d80d4238fe02d2baaaaf

contact_id.description: The Apollo contact_id to associate with the task. Either contact_id, account_id, or opportunity_id is required. Example: 6a0af1f3f1ce1100203b8047

account_id.description: The Apollo account_id to associate with the task. Either contact_id, account_id, or opportunity_id is required.

opportunity_id.description: The Apollo opportunity_id to associate with the task. Either contact_id, account_id, or opportunity_id is required.

type.description: The type of task to create.

status.description: The status of the task. Use scheduled for future tasks, completed or skipped for past tasks.

due_at.description: The due date and time in ISO 8601 format. Apollo uses GMT by default. Example: 2025-02-15T08:10:30Z

priority.description: The priority of the task. Defaults to medium.

title.description: A title for the task. If omitted, Apollo auto-generates a title. Example: Follow up on demo request

note.description: A description or note for the task. Example: Discuss product demo results and next steps.

original_task_id.description: The ID of the task that was requested to be updated. Note: The original task still exists and should be manually deleted in the Apollo UI.

syncs.description: Sync organizations matching saved Apollo filters
syncs.name: organization-search
